title: Ecology federal permits record: Fortna Dock Replacement (Aquatics 142654)

licence.text: Use allowed with credit and a link; commercial and political use prohibited

rows.label: What the project is
rows.value: 2025 - The applicant propose to remove the existing 3.75 foot by 43.25 foot timber pier, two ten inch diameter creosote timber piles, a 2.5 foot by 40 foot solid decked aluminum ramp, and an “L” shaped float consisting of one 4 foot by 7.5 foot float and one 8 foot by 33 foot float. The applicant proposes to install a 4 foot wide by 31 foot long grated aluminum pier, a 3 foot wide by 48 foot long (with only 42.75 feet overwater) grated ramp, an 7 foot wide by 28 foot long float with feet, a 5 foot by 6 foot ramp landing float and two 12 inch diameter galvanized steel piles. The proposed structure will be installed within the footprint of the existing structure. The new pier, ramp and float will be fully grated with fiberglass reinforced plastic grating that meets or exceeds 60% open space. Piles will be installed with a vibratory hammer or rock drill as necessary.
